draft_text: Ferrule generally achieved a higher test AUROC than Arbor-GBT across the six-dataset tabular suite.
revised_text: Ferrule achieved a higher test AUROC than Arbor-GBT on five of the six datasets in the suite, with Arbor-GBT higher on Ivel-Fraud.
rationale: T1 shows Ferrule higher on 5 of 6 datasets (r1, r2, r4, r5, r6) but lower on Ivel-Fraud (r3: 92.3 vs 92.8). The claim is supported at a narrower, exception-noting strength.
